# Multicollinearity

All fitted-covariate VIF and design condition numbers are in spatial_vif.csv. Luminal and epithelial scores share four genes; library depth and detected genes are correlated. These adjusted models are conditional descriptive sensitivities. Do not interpret attenuation as causal mediation. Per-section coefficients can reverse sign. No inferred cell fraction or validated tumor-region annotation is available.
